panel.title: Access tokens
panel.description: Long-lived tokens that let a script or an integration call the API on your behalf.

revoke-confirm.title: Revoke this token?
revoke-confirm.description: Anything still using it stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.

dialog.title: Create an access token
dialog.description: Name it after where you will use it, so you can tell your tokens apart later.
dialog.issued-note: Copy it now — this is the only time it is shown.
